name: PeakLedger
metaDescription: PeakLedger is a LifeLoom app for discovering mountain peaks on an interactive map and keeping a record of the peaks you have climbed.
summary: Discover mountain peaks, explore them on a map and keep a personal record of the summits you have climbed.

hero.heading: Keep a ledger of every summit.
hero.description: PeakLedger brings mountain peaks together on an interactive map and gives you a simple way to record the summits you have climbed.

section.heading: Discover. Climb. Remember.
section.description: A focused way to explore peaks and build a lasting record of the places you have reached.

features.title: Interactive peak map
features.description: Explore mountain peaks geographically and see what is around you.

features.title: Climb tracking
features.description: Mark peaks as climbed and build your own personal summit record.

features.title: Peak information
features.description: Keep useful mountain and elevation information together in one place.

features.title: Personal progress
features.description: See your growing collection of completed peaks as you explore more.
